subject: The dignity of language
alt: Cartoon: under a picture of a big leader on the wall, a leader in a saffron gamchha shouts in anger: indecent, obscene, insulting! These people are answering us in our own language.
chutki: There is much debate about the language of politics, but this cartoon says one plain thing: whoever farmed abuse will have the harvest cut in his own courtyard. The stars dancing above the leader's head show that the reply has landed, and exactly where it should have.

The fun is in 'our own language'. That is, the complaint is not about indecency but about copyright. When a language patented in one's own name is spoken by someone else, it suddenly becomes obscene. The picture on the wall behind is smiling, perhaps because this school of language began right there.
